recipes.title: Rainbow Yogurt Parfait
recipes.durationStatus: ESTIMATE — not timed in usability testing; excludes any waiting/cooling
recipes.description: Build colorful layers of creamy yogurt, fresh berries and a little crunch.

steps.title: Wash up and rinse the berries
steps.instruction: Wash your hands with soap and water. An adult can help rinse the strawberries and blueberries under cool running water, then pat them dry.
steps.safety: Use clean hands, a clean colander and clean surfaces.

steps.title: Spoon in the yogurt
steps.instruction: Add a spoonful of plain yogurt to the bottom of your cup. Smooth it gently so the next layer shows.
steps.safety: Keep the yogurt chilled until you are ready to build your cup.

steps.title: Make berry layers
steps.instruction: Add a few strawberries and blueberries, then another spoonful of yogurt. Repeat to make your own color pattern.
steps.safety: Ask an adult to cut any large strawberries with a suitable knife.

steps.title: Finish with a little crunch
steps.instruction: Sprinkle granola on top. Add a tiny drizzle of honey if you like, then enjoy right away.
steps.safety: Check the granola label for allergens. Honey is optional.

recipes.title: Mini Pizza Toast
recipes.durationStatus: ESTIMATE — not timed in usability testing; excludes adult-controlled appliance time
recipes.description: Turn a slice of toast into a little cheesy pizza with colorful toppings.
recipes.crossContact: Check bread, sauce and cheese labels. Use clean utensils and a clean preparation surface.
recipes.adultHelp: Adult required for every air-fryer operation: preheating, loading, removing the toast and handling the hot basket or tray. Let the toast cool before eating.

nutrition.dataSource: USDA FoodData Central records must be mapped to the exact bread, sauce, cheese and topping forms before calculation.
nutrition.calculationMethod: Not calculated yet. Brand-specific bread and sauce variation must be resolved.
nutrition.verificationStatus: BLOCKED — nutrition values not verified; independent review pending

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.instruction: Place the bread on a clean preparation surface. Spread the pizza sauce over the top, leaving a small edge.
steps.safety: Keep the bread on a stable board. Wash hands first.

steps.title: Add cheese and toppings
steps.instruction: Sprinkle mozzarella evenly over the sauce. Add a few pepper pieces and olives if you like.
steps.safety: Check ingredient labels for allergens. Keep toppings small and easy to bite.

steps.title: Ask an adult to air-fry it
steps.instruction: An adult places the toast in the air fryer and chooses the appliance instructions for a small piece of bread with cheese. Appliance models vary, so the adult checks it closely.
steps.safety: ADULT ONLY: preheating, placing food in, removing food and handling the hot basket. Do not set a universal time or temperature.

steps.title: Cool, then enjoy
steps.instruction: An adult moves the toast to a cool plate. Wait until the cheese and bread are comfortably cool before taking a bite.
steps.safety: Hot cheese and equipment can burn. The adult checks the food and serves it when safe.
